remarks: Charming single-story ranch on a quiet, tree-lined street in Mount Carmel. Every bedroom is on one level with no stairs anywhere in the home — a practical layout for anyone who doesn't want to manage steps day to day. Updated kitchen with quartz counters and stainless appliances opens to a bright dining area. Original hardwood floors throughout the living spaces. Detached garage has been converted into a flexible bonus room, ideal as a home office or gym. Low-maintenance backyard with a mature lemon tree and space for a small garden. Walk to Hopkins Avenue shops and cafes.

Spacious hillside contemporary with sweeping bay views from the main living level. Vaulted ceilings and walls of glass fill the home with natural light. Remodeled kitchen features a large island, perfect for entertaining. Dedicated office off the primary suite with built-in shelving, ideal for remote work. Multi-level deck steps down to a flat, fenced backyard. Located on a peaceful cul-de-sac away from through traffic. Bedrooms are split across two levels, including stairs from the entry to the main living floor.

Move-in-ready cottage just blocks from Woodside Plaza shopping center. Home sits directly on Woodside Road, a busy arterial street with steady traffic noise, especially at the front-facing bedrooms. Recently painted interior and updated bathroom. Compact backyard, well suited to low-maintenance landscaping rather than a large garden. Good starter home or investment property given rental demand nearby.

Beautifully preserved single-story mid-century home on a quiet residential street in Farm Hill — all bedrooms and living space on one level, no interior stairs. Open-beam ceilings and original terrazzo flooring in the entry. Kitchen has been tastefully updated while keeping period character, with butcher block counters and a farmhouse sink. A converted den off the garage functions well as a home office or playroom. Large, private backyard with a stone patio and drought-tolerant landscaping. No through traffic on this street.

Cozy two-bedroom bungalow, a great entry point into Redwood City ownership. Original single-pane windows and dated kitchen and bath present an opportunity for the right buyer to renovate and build equity. Small, sunny backyard. Located near Fair Oaks Community Center. Some road noise from Fair Oaks Avenue during commute hours.

Elegant two-story traditional on one of Emerald Hills' most sought-after streets. Chef's kitchen with a large island flows into a family room with a stone fireplace. A dedicated first-floor office with French doors provides a quiet, private workspace separate from the main living areas. Primary suite and three secondary bedrooms are upstairs; a fifth bedroom on the main floor could work as a downstairs guest room, though most living happens across two levels. Manicured, fully fenced backyard with a built-in outdoor kitchen. Extremely quiet, low-traffic street with mature trees.

Light-filled single-story ranch on a peaceful residential street near Red Morton Park, with every bedroom on the main level and no stairs to navigate. Updated eat-in kitchen with new cabinetry. Spare bedroom currently set up as a home office, easily converted back to a bedroom. Newly landscaped front yard with drought-tolerant plantings. Large side yard offers room for a dog run or garden beds. Minimal through traffic, popular with families for its proximity to parks and trails.

Newer construction modern farmhouse on a private, gated cul-de-sac (HOA covers gate maintenance and common-area landscaping). High-end finishes throughout including wide-plank white oak floors and a Wolf/Sub-Zero kitchen. Main-floor guest suite doubles as a home office with its own entrance — a full bedroom and bath are available downstairs, though the primary suite and most bedrooms are upstairs. Resort-style backyard with a pool, spa, and covered outdoor living room with fireplace. One of the quietest streets in the neighborhood, no through traffic whatsoever.

Affordable entry point on Middlefield Road, a busy commercial corridor with significant vehicle and bus traffic at all hours. Dated interior throughout, needs a full kitchen and bath remodel. Small, mostly paved backyard. Best suited for an investor or buyer prioritizing price over quiet or move-in condition.

Sunny single-story home on a quiet interior street with no through traffic, every room on one level. Recently remodeled kitchen with white shaker cabinets and quartz counters opens to a family room. Third bedroom has been thoughtfully converted into a home office with custom built-in desk and shelving, easily reverted to a bedroom if needed. Landscaped backyard with a covered patio, great for year-round outdoor dining. Close to Stulsaft Park.

Single-level ranch purpose-suited for accessible, one-story living — no stairs anywhere on the property, including a zero-step entry from the driveway to the front door. Primary bedroom and a full bath are positioned near the front of the home for easy access, with wide hallways throughout. Walk-in shower with a built-in bench in the primary bath. Flat, low-maintenance backyard with a paved path connecting the patio to the side gate. Quiet residential street set back from Alameda de las Pulgas' main traffic lanes. A second bedroom works well as a home office or space for a caregiver.

Downsized single-story home ideal for buyers who want everything on one level without the upkeep of a larger property. Both bedrooms, including the primary, sit on the main floor with no stairs to manage. Updated bathroom includes grab bars and a curbless shower. Flat driveway with no steps to the front entry. Small, easy-care backyard with raised garden beds at an accessible height. Quiet, low-traffic street popular with longtime residents.

Waterfront condo in a gated Redwood Shores community with lagoon views from the primary bedroom and living room. HOA covers the pool, fitness center, landscaping, and exterior maintenance — a low-maintenance option for buyers who don't want yard work. Second bedroom currently used as a home office. Single-level unit with no interior stairs, in-unit washer/dryer, and a reserved covered parking spot. Quiet building on a private street, no through traffic. Easy access to the Bay Trail for walking and biking.

Walkable downtown condo two blocks from the Caltrain station and Courthouse Square — ideal for a commuter who doesn't want a car-dependent lifestyle. HOA includes water, garbage, and building maintenance. Building can have some street and foot-traffic noise given the central location, especially on weekend evenings when downtown restaurants are busy. Updated kitchen with butcher block counters. In-building laundry room (not in-unit). Assigned parking space included.
